interpretation: The 48/64/96-token caps were intentionally strict and exposed a production-relevant truncation hazard. HTTP 200 alone did not mean a complete executable tool call. A four-request compact-schema follow-up completed one single-tool and one two-tool round trip while keeping the combined actual request total at 30.
